of.needed: whether CRDs are installed separately from the external-secrets Helm chart or application manifests

consequence.statement: CRDs must be upgraded to v0.16.1 before the external-secrets application itself is upgraded; upgrading the application first without updating CRDs separately may cause compatibility issues.

assertion.statement: When CRDs are installed separately, operators must first apply the v0.16.1 CRDs bundle before upgrading external-secrets to v0.16.1.
